title: How Much Does Video Editing Cost in the UK? Reels, YouTube and Podcasts (2026)
meta_title: Video Editing Cost UK: Reels, YouTube, Podcasts (2026)
meta_description: UK video editors charge £25–£75 an hour or £50–£400 a day. Prices per Reel, YouTube video and podcast, and when a monthly editing plan works out cheaper.
keywords: how much does video editing cost uk

faq.q: How much does a video editor cost per hour in the UK?
faq.a: UK freelance video editors typically charge £25 to £75 an hour. Beginners sit at the lower end, while experienced editors and motion designers charge more.

faq.q: How much does it cost to edit a Reel or TikTok?
faq.a: Usually £30 to £150 per video from a UK freelancer, depending on captions, B-roll and how much raw footage there is. Monthly plans bring the per-video price down.

faq.q: How much does podcast editing cost in the UK?
faq.a: A one-hour podcast typically costs £75 to £300 to edit, more if it's filmed with several cameras or needs short clips cut for social media.

faq.q: How long does it take to edit a video?
faq.a: A simple Reel can take one to two hours; a 10-minute YouTube video often takes a full day. Turnaround depends on the editor's workload and revision rounds.

faq.q: Is it cheaper to edit videos myself?
faq.a: Apps like CapCut make basic edits easy and free. The cost is time: most business owners find a few hours a week of editing isn't the best use of it.

faq.q: Should I pay per video or monthly?
faq.a: Pay per video for occasional one-offs. If you post every week, a monthly plan usually costs less and gives you consistent quality and turnaround.
